name: Year Views
description: Provide a configurable 'dropdown' view filter for a user-friendly exposed year filter.
project_description:
Year provides a custom, integer-based field to capture only the year part of a date.

 
 ⚠️ Future Deprecation 
 Year is still fully supported, but will someday be deprecated (with migration path) in favor of Year Only . 

 See [#3381046] for details and updates.

 
 Features 
 
 Two included widgets : text field and select list (with sort option). 
 Flexible min, max and default values . Set field constraints and default value using explicit numbers, or relative date strings ('+5 years', 'now', etc.). 
 Dropdown year filter . Enable the year_views sub-module for a custom 'dropdown' views filter with a configurable range of years for more user-friendly exposed filters. 
 Support for Feeds .
